title: Get your Windows license refund
summary: A consumer advocacy guide helping users exercise their legal rights to request refunds for unused or unwanted Windows licenses, potentially leveraging EU consumer protection laws and Microsoft's refund policies.
problem_solved: Helps consumers recover money spent on Windows licenses they don't use or didn't intend to purchase.
why_valuable: Empowers users to reclaim software costs through legitimate refund requests, potentially saving hundreds of dollars per license.
